headline: Sin-fall leads at the turn-12 cap after eliminating Dumpster-Diver Crab

result.summary: A kicked Tear Asunder exiles Homer on turn 4. Entomb plus a clean Sin lottery copies Portal to Phyrexia on turn 7. Dawnsire's 100-damage trigger hits Sin on turn 9, then Portal eats the ship. Sin recasts and commander-kills Homer on turn 11; the cap hits with Sin-fall at 40, Misty Critters at 15, and Osgir at 37.
